info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Cross-Channel Contact Routing Reviews API
info.description: This API facilitates the submission of reviews related to cross-channel contact routing in banking services. Businesses can utilize this endpoint to gather, analyze, and respond to customer feedback, enhancing service quality and customer satisfaction. Typical consumers include customer support teams, product managers, and analysts seeking to track customer experiences across different banking channels. By providing insights into user opinions, this API serves as a vital tool for continuous improvement and service optimization.

post.summary: Create a review for the specified contact routing resource.
post.description: This endpoint allows the user to submit a new review for the contact routing resource identified by RES-100045. Providing detailed feedback helps improve services and supports continuous development.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a review for the specific contact routing endpoint identified by RES-100045. It expects a JSON payload containing the review details.
